# WinStaff Solutions

> WinStaff Solutions is an offshore recruitment partner for US employers and staffing firms. From its delivery center in Pune, India, it provides talent sourcing, full-cycle recruiting, dedicated offshore recruiters and recruitment process outsourcing (RPO), working on US time zones as an extension of the client's team.

Key facts:
- Clients: US employers (direct hiring teams) and US staffing and recruiting firms.
- Head office: Office No: 1610, Tower 09, Bramhacorp Business Park, New Kalyani Nagar, Pune, Maharashtra 411014, India.
- Phone: +91 92255 20510
- Email: contact@beaconmartech.com
- Talent markets: Information Technology; Semiconductor and Electronics; Engineering and Manufacturing; Corporate and Professional Services.
- Engagement models: dedicated sourcer/recruiter, partial RPO, end-to-end RPO, project-based RPO.
- Contact: see the contact page to book a free 30-minute consultation.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://www.winstaffsolutions.com/services/): Talent sourcing, recruiting services, and RPO and dedicated teams.
- [Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO)](https://www.winstaffsolutions.com/services/rpo/): End-to-end and partial RPO, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, dedicated recruitment teams, reporting, high-volume hiring and offer management.
